$comment: The live newsroom's contract: a fictional newsroom (Meridian News) played by one process per role, each on its own connections, reacting to each other through the bus. examples/newsroom implements it; its tests check the actors against this file.

trigger.what: Plays the pack's ambient day: each story beat as the next story.context snapshot (the break, the updates, the correction, the kill).

reactions.when: Media for one of its stories lands: the next snapshot attaches it as an asset.

trigger.what: Files the tip-line clip as an orphan story (source UNVERIFIED) early in the day.

reactions.when: A story's first snapshot (sequence 1) asks for coverage: the press-conference feed lands.
Every snapshot: the reference executor evaluates the house's raise-flag-on-match instances and raises what matches (UNVERIFIED source, HIGH priority).
A snapshot carries an on-screen element (the outage lower third): books it, gate PENDING. A kill: withdraws what it booked.
A link waits on a PENDING gate: clears it and records why.
A booked link's gate is cleared: takes it to air.
A kill: takes what is on air off.
A story goes to air: puts it on the live web page.
A kill: ends its web publication.
A kill: suppresses what the story left behind and records it.
